title: Leader / Laggard Spread (BDI1028-LLS): at 10:30 or 12:00 buy the N strongest names vs QQQ above VWAP and short the N weakest below VWAP, equal R per leg, one basket per day
hypothesis: bdi1027's index-reclaim leaders beat the same-minute random long but lost in down sessions (a direction bet). Trading the leaders and the laggards together at a fixed minute should keep the selection edge and cancel the index move.
notes: Two-year open history, costs in, locked block not read, no holdout. 8 configs (T 10:30/12:00 x N 5/10 x hold/t1s1), 0 pass, 0 near-miss: basket avg R -0.025..-0.112 (best T1200 N5 hold -0.025R, t -0.90; train +0.007 / valid -0.064), negative in up and down sessions in 7 of 8 rows. What it learned: the 12:00 long leaders beat the same-minute random long in train and valid in all 4 rows (+0.01..+0.10R), the laggard shorts beat random in train but not in valid; the random baseline itself is about -0.08R after costs, so the selection edge is smaller than two legs of costs. Lineage counted with the relative-strength family (N 761, bar 3.64). Educational only - not financial advice.
